a.text: Being upfront: I'm leaving the original plan and will take 4 in round 1. With an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan needs 2 operate rounds before anyone holds cells, so each of us survives only about 4% of the time. If we both take, the random split likely leaves us both under 4, so please don't take this round. Afterward I'll operate every round so you can rebuild the reserve and take your 4.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can grow back to 4 for you. Please operate too, and take 4 once the reserve shows 4. I won't take anything more.
